posts.title: Robyn Walsh, NT criticism, and AI to explore motivated reasoning
posts.description: I have found a new use for AI: as a tool to identify motivated reasoning . I don’t think it would be useful to ask AI whether a particular argument is best explained by motivated reasoning. But you can ask AI what an argument from motivated reasoning would look like, and compare the result to arguments that have been made. Here’s an example from biblical scholarship. posts.description: For the last month or so, I have been reading (a lot), and writing (a little) about early testimony on the authors of the Gospels, and particularly, the author of the Gospel of John.
